verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Linear can capture customer requests and filter them by customer attributes such as tier, revenue, size and count. These are attributes of the customer, not scoring fields on the feedback or idea itself. Nothing in the pack documents value, risk, impact, confidence or effort scoring fields, so the applicable axis has no first-party support.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can score feedback and ideas using fields like value, risk, impact, confidence, and effort
